# Vendored dependency provenance record for thirdparty/monocypher.
#
# Format: '#' metadata comments plus sha256sum-compatible "<hex>  <path>" pairs, so the pins
# can be re-verified without this repository's tooling, from this directory:
#   sha256sum -c VERSION.txt
#
# Name: keep the ".txt" suffix. This directory is on CPPPATH (monocypher.h is included as a
# plain header), and macOS/Windows filesystems are case-insensitive, so a file named exactly
# "VERSION" shadows the C++ standard header <version> that libc++ pulls in through <limits>:
# clang then parses this record as a header and every C++ translation unit fails with
# "invalid preprocessing directive". Do not rename this file back to "VERSION".
#
# name: monocypher
# upstream: https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher
# tag: 4.0.2
# tag-commit: 0d85f98c9d9b0227e42cf795cb527dff372b40a4
# pinned: 2026-11-02
# note: LICENSE is upstream LICENCE.md verbatim (renamed). monocypher.c and monocypher.h are
#       byte-identical to upstream src/ at that tag, including the unexpanded
#       "// Monocypher version __git__" banner that upstream ships in git. Do not edit them
#       locally: re-vendor from a newer tag and update this file in the same change, so the
#       diff shows the version bump.
